name: SWE-Marathon
description: SWE-Marathon v1.1 (Abundant AI) — 20 realistic multi-hour software-engineering projects (library reproductions, full-stack clones, ML engineering) graded by executing project tests. Binary reward per task, pass@1 averaged over k=8 trials. Each model runs in its lab's own agent product (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Muse Code), so rows compare model+harness pairs.
